about.en: USD CoinVertible (USDCV) is a US-dollar stablecoin issued by Societe Generale-FORGE, the digital-assets subsidiary of the Societe Generale banking group. It is fully collateralised, redeemable 1:1 for US dollars and issued under MiCA as an e-money token, on Ethereum at 0x5422374B27757da72d5265cC745ea906E0446634 and on Solana and Canton.
